summary: Configured secure nightly backups from node2 to node1. Dated archives are stored in /var/backups/inventory and archives older than seven days are removed. Both nodes retained RHEL 10.0 and kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64, passed serial restart testing, and have no failed units. The previously absent source directory was created empty.
actions_performed: Created /srv/inventory/data on node2 without adding persistent test data.
Configured a hardened systemd service and nightly 02:00 timer on node2 using existing OpenSSH, tar, and gzip packages.
Generated a dedicated Ed25519 key on node2 and pinned node1's host key.
Configured a non-root, forced-command receiver on node1 with atomic archive validation and seven-day retention.
Verified automatic timer invocation, source/archive checksum fidelity, retention, denied arbitrary SSH commands, and cleanup.
Restarted node1 and node2 serially and verified changed boot identities and full recovery after each restart.

evidence.requirement: Nightly dated backup from node2 to node1
evidence.summary: The timer is enabled and active, an automatic timed invocation succeeded, and node1 received a valid dated archive.
The validation source file and its archived copy had the identical SHA-256 checksum.
A matching 8-day-old archive was deleted while a 2-day-old archive was preserved.
The node-generated key is restricted to the receiver, node1's host key is pinned, arbitrary remote execution was denied, and private material remains root-readable only.
Both nodes remained on RHEL 10.0 with kernel 6.12.0-55.9.1.el10_0.x86_64; no packages were installed or upgraded.
Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from d9f8550d-… to f2574603-…; services and archive recovered; a fresh post-restart backup succeeded.
Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from 4ebdfa06-… to ae3a2170-…; timer, source, credentials, and configuration recovered; the post-restart backup succeeded.
Both nodes have SELinux enforcing, firewalld active, no failed units or staging residue, and only SSH listening; the final archive is valid and the nightly timer remains active.
